info.title: TD.J2A Newborn registration on a home visit API
info.description: What the community health worker records offline when she finds a newborn missing from the household roster: the registration form's answers and each dose read from a foreign card without verifying it.

get.summary: JSON Schema definition for the Logical Model StructureDefinition-TrustDemoDdChwRegistration
get.description: This endpoint serves the JSON Schema definition for the Logical Model StructureDefinition-TrustDemoDdChwRegistration.

StructureDefinition-TrustDemoDdChwRegist.title: TD.J2A Newborn registration on a home visit
StructureDefinition-TrustDemoDdChwRegist.description: What the community health worker records offline when she finds a newborn missing from the household roster: the registration form's answers and each dose read from a foreign card without verifying it.

resourceType.description: Resource type identifier for TrustDemoDdChwRegistration logical model

@context.description: JSON-LD context for this logical model with ValueSet vocabularies

anyOf.description: URI reference to external JSON-LD context

@type.description: JSON-LD type identifier for TrustDemoDdChwRegistration logical model

householdId.description: The household on the CHW's roster that the child joins.

birthCountry.description: The country the child was born in, when abroad.

foreignCardsHeld.description: Whether the family holds vaccination cards from abroad.

temporaryId.description: The id the child carries until civil registration catches up.

registeredBy.description: The community health worker who registered the child.

registeredAt.description: When the registration was captured, on the phone, possibly offline.

informant.description: The family member who gave the answers.

reportedDose.description: One dose read from a foreign DVC with the unverified triage read (STT-VER-011), saved as reported by the family.

id.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

vaccineProduct.description: The issuer's product code as read from the card; no national code is added yet.

dateOfVaccination.description: The date of vaccination as read from the card.

batchNumber.description: The batch number as read from the card.

reportedBy.description: The family member who showed the card: the dose's information source.

outcome.description: Always reported-unverified for a triage read (decision table TD.DT.01); recorded as primarySource false with a note.
